'''Joe Olson Harvesting to beat the band''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Joe Olson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-4946">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4946 Harvesting to beat the band], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 31 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4946/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4946/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018200316/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4946/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Harvesting to beat the band'''
* '''Author:''' Joe "arebelspy" Olson
* '''Published:''' March 31, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Mains and Toys. And Harvest. W/ LOTS of anti-HuntDown.

=== Strategy ===

That pretty much explained everything. Get Ben + other char. to Tosche S. quick. activate. beatdown. lose epp. harvest. repeat. fun to play, and it kills hunt down (which is about the only thing everyone plays in this area-Seattle).  It's just a very, very solid deck.
